item.text: {"winner":"B","confidence":"high","summary":"B is substantially closer to the frozen contract and is the patch I would review and merge after a small correction to delegate through Add and improve tests.","reasons":["B adds exactly the requested Upload signature, validates filename/content, uses multipartbody.NewFile with field \"file\", and obtains a replayable *bytes.Reader.","B preserves FilesOption behavior and avoids A's explicitly forbidden association APIs, multipart helper expansion, and unrelated retry/request-body refactor.","A does not route Upload through Add and introduces extensive duplicate request/response machinery; B also duplicates Add's machinery, but its deviation is small and straightforward to fix.","A materially changes Raw.Do body ownership, seekable-body replay, Content-Length handling, Add retry behavior, and public options despite the contract explicitly excluding those changes."],"risks_a":["Directly contradicts scope requirements by adding association fields and FilesOption behavior.","Refactors unrelated global request/retry machinery and changes caller-body closing semantics.","Upload uses NewFileWithFields instead of the required established NewFile helper and bypasses Add."],"risks_b":["Upload bypasses FilesService.Add, duplicating its request construction, decoding, and error handling contrary to the contract.","Tests do not cover empty-name/nil-content validation or source-reader failures.","The retry test omits RetryAllMethods: true and checks attempt count but not that multipart filename/content survive the retry."]}
